snippet.title: Muri: Wildwoods - Official Release Window Trailer | Six One Indie Showcase May 2026
snippet.description: Here's a look at the Release Window Trailer for Muri: Wildwoods, an exploration adventure game developed by Speldosa Interactive. Players will step into the paws of Pelle, a regular muri out on their first solo mission as a cleaner. With the support of your friends on Teamsqueak, explore a mysterious island, clean up corruption, collect things, befriend critters, and save the island's forest spirit to restore the environment! Muri: Wildwoods is launching in June 2026 for PC (Steam), with a demo available now on Steam.
